svg.text: ESPACIO Embeddings & RAG Pipeline Architecture (4th Database: Vector DB)
End-to-end asynchronous Outbox ingestion, deterministic chunking, HNSW pre-filtered retrieval, INV-02 anti-hallucination guardrail & LLM/VLM synthesis

g.text: Phase A — Asynchronous Embeddings Ingestion & Indexing Pipeline (Zero Impact on Checkout Path)
Payload Indexes (Hard Pre-Filters BEFORE ANN Ranking):
Anti-Stale Rule: Closed/Rented listings purged from index in < 5s
Phase B — Online Hybrid RAG Retrieval, Deterministic Space-Fit Guardrail & LLM/VLM Synthesis
RAG Governance, Security & Observability Guardrails (QA & PROD)
• System instructions isolated from user query & property text
• Numeric dimensions always verified by SpaceFitCalculator (INV-02)
• If top similarity < 0.72, assistant replies: 'Insufficient verified data'
• Vector DB stores ONLY public AVAILABLE property specs & FAQs
• Zero PII (tenant emails, Stripe secrets, QR tokens) ever embedded
• Runtime MCP server runs strictly read-only with scoped OAuth2 token
• Logs correlationId, retrievalScore, tokenUsage, latencyMs in JSON
• Redis caches frequent FAQ RAG responses (TTL 15m)
• Sentry.io tracks embedding failures, timeouts & p95 latency > 3s

svg.text: ESPACIO Platform Architecture • Universidad Central del Ecuador (GPWP 2026–2027)
